name: Matsugami Susuki
source: [url=/c10457]Haruto's[/url] younger sister and a HUGE brocon. She would often come to his brother's place to play and ends up spending the night there. Her dreams for the future is to become her Onii-chan's bride. After learning about her brother and [url=/c10367]Ayano's[/url] relationship, she was shocked, but gradually warms up to Ayano due to her kind and warm nature.
